d: Short, messy silver-white hair with blue tips and side-swept bangs frames a youthful, mature face with sharp, narrow blue eyes. A slender build is dressed in a dark grey suit jacket over a white collared shirt and a blue necktie, complemented by a blue and gold shoulder cape. The look is accessorized with round, purple-tinted gradient glasses and a black fingerless glove on the hand holding a black handgun.
